purpose: First attribute cohort of the compiler-enforced safe-interior programme: discover five candidate islands on the exact source, then mark each declaration with #[forbid(unsafe_code)] so the compiler, not a review checklist, keeps the island free of unsafe constructs. Attribute-only edits; no body changes, no new dependencies, no commit or push.
